title: inventory (agent -> hub)
description: Full snapshot of hardware, disks, cache and running instances. Sent right after hello_ack, every intervals.inventory_seconds, and after any change the agent detects (device health, cache state, instance state). The hub treats it as authoritative and reconciles the devices, node_model_cache and instances tables (instances the hub expects but the agent does not report are marked error unless a command for them is in flight).

engine_processes.description: Shared engine processes (llama.cpp router) and the instances attached to them.

ssh_instances.description: SSH GPU containers managed by the agent (added 2026-11-17). Authoritative like instances: ones the hub expects but the agent does not report are gone.

observed_engines.description: Model servers configured in agent.toml [[observe]] (added 2026-11-23). Authoritative: external deployments the hub knows for this node but the agent no longer reports become stale.

agent_update.description: Self-update state (protocol.md §14); sent only to a hub listing the agent_updates feature.
